speaker: margery_pell
text: Thin. Errors, and they listened, and I am still not putting a sum in anyone's mouth.

speaker: john_heminges
text: Then we will not have one. I am not setting a figure on this afternoon, and I will not borrow one to make the book look finished.

speaker: will_kemp
text: A thin house, and the jig went on. The jig does not ask the yard how many it brought. You may keep your blank, John.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: You, and the jig. That is the afternoon. I have nothing to add to a blank.

speaker: john_heminges
text: The flag was up. I am not writing a number under it.

speaker: margery_pell
text: I stood the stair. I know a thin house when I have stood in it, and this was one.

speaker: will_kemp
text: Then say thin, and have done. I will not do the jig a second time in the telling of it.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Errors is done. There is no figure, and there is no second matter.

speaker: john_heminges
text: Old comedy. Thin house. The blank stands. I will write that, and I will write no number beside it.

speaker: margery_pell
text: Write thin. Do not ask me for the other house. I did not stand their stair.

speaker: will_kemp
text: I am not asking her for theirs. I am not asking anyone for a figure.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Then nobody is getting one. The morning is not a matter for this table.

speaker: john_heminges
text: No second matter. I will not borrow a week that is not this one to finish the line.

speaker: margery_pell
text: And I am willing to leave it entered that way. Do not ask me again on the stair.

speaker: will_kemp
text: I will not. I have a jig to get out of my knees. You may all go and be serious somewhere else.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: We are done. God give you the road.

speaker: john_heminges
text: And you. The flag was up. The house was thin. That is the day I am willing to enter.

speaker: margery_pell
text: Leave it. Thin is the word, and the word is enough.

speaker: will_kemp
text: By my hose, that is still a long way round a quiet box. I accept the quiet.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Then the quiet stands. I have nothing else to set beside it.

speaker: john_heminges
text: The book can close on that. No sum. No second line.

speaker: margery_pell
text: I will lock my stair on thin, and on nothing else.

speaker: will_kemp
text: Lock it. I am for the ditch, and I am not taking a riddle with me.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Go, then. The afternoon is the play, and the play is done.

speaker: john_heminges
text: Done. God keep the blank a blank.
